## Summary

Describe the problem, the chosen solution, and the user-visible result.

## Related issue

Closes #

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Release preparation

## Validation

List the commands and manual scenarios used to verify this change.

```text
npm run release
```

## Security and provider impact

Describe changes to credentials, OAuth scopes, permissions, stored data, network
access, migrations, provider limits, or release packaging. Write `None` when not applicable.

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visible UI changes, or write `Not applicable`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue when appropriate.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or the reason they do not is documented.
- [ ] Documentation and migration notes are updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private provider links, or personal data are committed or logged.
- [ ] Provider limits and failure/repair paths remain explicit.
- [ ] `npm run release` passes locally, or failures are explained above.
- [ ] Breaking changes and rollback steps are documented.
